responsibility: Implements C-family spellchecking support for preprocessor macro names in diagnostics. It filters which macros are reasonable suggestions, avoids suggesting implementation-reserved user macros, and drives edit-distance-based nearest-match searches over cpplib identifiers so higher-level diagnostics can propose likely intended macro names.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for macro-name spellchecking: it decides which macros are eligible suggestions and performs the nearest-match scan over cpplib identifiers, whereas c-spellcheck.h declares the API and template specializations that describe macros as edit-distance candidates.
